_doc: Documented exceptions of the organization source guards. Every entry needs an owner and a reason, and a stale entry (the token no longer appears) fails the guard.

allow.reason: type-level placeholder in `type Need`: no capability uses it and it is not a canonical permission (backend access/Permission.kt CANONICAL has no ORG_*). Temporary: kept only while H-C1-17 is unresolved (D-C0-46).
allow.trigger: when C1 H-C1-17 freezes the exact organization permissions (or states that there are none)
allow.outcome: replace ORG_MANAGE in features/admin/organization.ts `type Need` with the canonical permission(s) C1 names, or remove the unused entry; THEN delete this allow-list entry. Until then ORG_MANAGE must stay unused: it is NOT a backend permission and must not be promoted or invented.
